title: Great Sufi saints
quote: Nizamuddin (Chishti, sama, aloof from the court) vs Sirhindi (Naqshbandi, orthodox, political critic)

boxes.title: Saint → contemporary ruler
head: Saint
Ruler / relation
rows: **Alauddin Khalji**, **Ghiyasuddin Tughlaq**; kept away from court
**Akbar** named his son Salim after him

items.what: **Bakhtiyar Kaki**: **Delhi** (Mehrauli); Qutub Minar's first storey dedicated to him

cards.title: Moinuddin Chishti
lines: Founder of Chishti order in India
⚠ other notes: order founded by **Abu Ishaq Shami** at Chisht (Herat)

boxes.title: Sirhindi vs Akbar
items: Purge "un-Islamic" practices; opposed **sama** and visits to saints' tombs
Urged limited contact with Hindus and Shias
Doctrine: ==**Wahdat-ush-Shuhud**== (Unity of Appearance) vs **Wahdat-ul-Wujud** (Unity of Being)

boxes.title: Chishti stance & legacy
items: Avoided political power; later **Deccan** Chishtis accepted grants
**Amir Khusrau**: disciple of Nizamuddin; introduced **Qaul** of Qawwali
Ajmer and Delhi dargahs = shared shrines of Hindus and Muslims
**Dargah Committee** runs Dargah Khwaja Saheb, Ajmer; Urs **Operations Manual**: ==**4 January 2025**==

boxes.title: Exam corner
items: Fawaid-ul-Fuad = ==**Amir Hasan Sijzi**== (UPPSC 2021); traps: Amir Khusrau, Barani, Hasan Nizami
**Iltutmish** = contemporary of both Bakhtiyar Kaki (Chishti) and Bahauddin Zakariya (Suhrawardi)
